analyst_view.overall: Lens (11th) and Toulouse (12th) are level on 13 points, but Lens come in after a 9-1 Champions League defeat at Como, two league defeats and the sacking of Yannick Cahuzac; Didier Digard takes charge for the first time. His first squad brings back Ganiou and Sima after weeks out, though both may start on the bench, but leaves out forward Franjo Ivanović and defender Jonathan Gradit (no reason given; Lensois says Ivanović was hurt late in the week), on top of Édouard, Bulatović and Nawrocki, who are counted. Toulouse (Jens Berthel Askou) miss Messali (counted) but have Dønnum, Amougou and Abu Francis back, with Tengstedt (five goals) leading the line. Referee Bastien Dechepy (4.4 cards a game) is already in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals, partly because Lens have leaked heavily lately. Ivanović is now out too, which the numbers don't know, leaving Thauvin, Hazard and Sotoca with Sima only half-ready, and a new coach after a 9-1 defeat will want a solid first game; Gradit's absence at the back pulls slightly the other way, so I keep a small trim to about 2.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners. Lens are expected in a 3-4-3 with wing-backs Aguilar and Udol and Digard wants play down the flanks, while Toulouse play a 4-4-2; that is close to how both usually play, so I stay at 9.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.8 cards and already add Dechepy's strict record (about +15%) and past meetings. A first game under a new coach brings energy but also more attention to discipline, and nothing points either way, so I stay at 4.8.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.9 shots. Digard's pressing could add a few for Lens, but Toulouse create a lot without finishing and Lens are short of fit forwards; these balance out, so I stay at 24.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 shots on target. With Ivanović now left out, Sima not fully fit and Édouard injured (counted), Lens have less sharpness up front than the numbers allow for, so I trim a little more, to about 8.5.
